integrity: All scientific premises independently derived from the Markov generator and periodization algebra. Strict rank proved for a specifically defined periodized circulant, not globally optimized over circulants. Exact arithmetic checker supports but does not replace universal proof. No external independent audit performed.
limitations: Stationary initial joint gene–mRNA law, two-state promoter, linear death, equally spaced scalar measurements, exact covariance but generally non-Gaussian observations. No theorem on likelihood calibration or posterior error; transient sample initialization not addressed.
title: Exact rank-four correction to finite-window Fourier covariance in a stochastic gene-switching model
